song.name: Eclipse of Destiny
song.plot: The final ritual during the total eclipse. Anya prepares to seal the rift, standing alone against the dark as the Great Darkness closes in.
song.analysis: The final ritual during the total eclipse. Anya prepares to seal the rift. Full structure restored (kept song); light anchors grafted: the Great Darkness, the Rift, the sealing of the night.

section.name: Verse 1
section.original: In the twilight's fleeting grace, We chase the shadows, face to face, A cosmic dance of dark and light, In the eclipse, our fate ignites.
section.reworked: In the twilight's fleeting grace, We chase the shadows, face to face, A cosmic dance of dark and light, In the Great Darkness, fate ignites.

section.name: Verse 2
section.original: Winds of change and timeless flow, In the silence, truths we know, Guided by the stars above, Through the void, on wings of love.
section.reworked: Winds of change and timeless flow, In the silence, truths we know, Guided by the stars above, Through the Rift, on wings of love.

section.name: Pre-Chorus
section.original: Galaxies collide, our spirits soar, In the heart of chaos, we find more, Bound by destiny's embrace, In the eclipse, we find our place.
section.reworked: Galaxies collide, our spirits soar, In the heart of chaos, we find more, Bound by destiny's embrace, In the eclipse, we find our place.

section.name: Chorus
section.original: Eclipse of destiny, where legends are made, In the clash of shadows, our fears fade, Through the veil of darkness, we rise anew, In the eclipse, our faith is true.
section.reworked: Eclipse of destiny, where legends are made, In the clash of shadows, our fears fade, Through the veil of darkness, we rise anew, In the eclipse, our faith is true.
